definitions.explanation: Insurance that covers medical expenses. In Japan, this primarily refers to the public health insurance system that covers all residents, but can also refer to supplementary private medical insurance.

examples.japanese: {医療保険|いりょうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧{皆|かい}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{医療保険|いりょうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, under the universal insurance system, everyone is covered by medical insurance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{民間|みんかん}→民間：13260_minkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{医療保険|いりょうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you take out private medical insurance, the burden of hospitalization costs becomes lighter.

notes:
Japan's public health insurance system ({国民皆保険|こくみんかいほけん}) is one of the most comprehensive in the world, covering all residents. Most people pay 30% of medical costs out of pocket, with insurance covering the rest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医療保険|いりょうほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧: to enroll in health insurance
- {医療保険|いりょうほけん}{制度|せいど}: health insurance system
- ⟦{公的|こうてき}→公的：06349_kouteki⟧{医療保険|いりょうほけん}: public health insurance
- ⟦{民間|みんかん}→民間：13260_minkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{医療保険|いりょうほけん}: private medical insurance

JAPAN'S SYSTEM:
- ⟦{健康保険|けんこうほけん}→健康保険：18475_kenkouhoken⟧ ({健保|けんぽ}): employee health insurance (for company workers)
- ⟦{国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん}→国民健康保険：24671_kokuminkenkouhoken⟧ ({国保|こくほ}): national health insurance (for self-employed and others)
- {後期高齢者医療保険|こうきこうれいしゃいりょうほけん}: medical insurance for the elderly (75+)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{保険証|ほけんしょう}→保険証：09707_hokenshou⟧: insurance card — the card you present at hospitals
- ⟦{自己負担|じこふたん}→自己負担：20462_jikofutan⟧: out-of-pocket expense
- ⟦{生命保険|せいめいほけん}→生命保険：18637_seimeihoken⟧: life insurance — different from medical insurance
